title: Swirling storm cloud over the lot between two houses, seen with neighbor Andy
summary: John Blitch tells of Swirling storm cloud over the lot between two houses, seen with neighbor Andy, about 2013 at Fort Collins, Colorado, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: looked like a miniature hurricane it was

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who has worked for DARPA, a US military research agency, says that in 2013 in Fort Collins, Colorado, he and his neighbor Andy saw a swirling storm cloud over the empty lot between two houses. He says it looked like a miniature hurricane. He tells it on a podcast with a host, Jesse Michels, as part of his account of being taken by non-human beings.
